title: Privacy Policy
intro: At SmartSaha, we are committed to respecting your privacy and safeguarding your personal data. This Privacy Policy outlines the types of information we collect, how we use it, and your rights regarding your data. By using our platform, you consent to the practices described herein.
section1_text: We collect information necessary to provide and improve our services, ensure security, and maintain compliance with legal requirements:
section1_list: Personal Information: Name, email address, phone number, and other contact details you voluntarily provide when subscribing, registering, or communicating with us.
Usage Data: Information about your interaction with our platform, including pages visited, features accessed, preferences, and performance metrics.
Technical Data: Device type, browser type, IP address, geolocation, and other system information necessary to optimize the platform and improve security.
Communication Data: Emails, inquiries, or feedback sent through our contact forms or other communication channels.
section2_text: SmartSaha uses your data to deliver efficient, personalized, and secure services. The purposes include:
section2_list: Providing, maintaining, and improving our platform and services.
Communicating relevant updates, news, offers, or events.
Conducting research and analytics to enhance user experience and operational efficiency.
Complying with legal obligations, preventing fraud, and protecting the rights and safety of users.
Enforcing our Terms of Use and resolving disputes.
section3_text: We value your trust and do not sell or rent personal information to third parties. Data may be shared under the following circumstances:
section3_list: With trusted service providers and partners who support platform operations.
To comply with legal requirements, governmental requests, or court orders.
To protect against fraudulent, unlawful, or unauthorized activity.
section4_text: SmartSaha implements industry-standard technical and organizational measures to protect your data against unauthorized access, misuse, disclosure, or destruction. Only authorized personnel have access to your information, and all access is monitored and logged.
section5_text: You have the right to access, correct, update, or delete your personal information. You may also request restrictions on processing or withdraw consent where applicable. To exercise your rights, contact us at
section6_text: We may use cookies and similar technologies to collect information about your browsing behavior. These tools help us improve user experience, analyze trends, and deliver personalized content. You may manage or disable cookies through your browser settings, but certain features may not function correctly.
section7_text: SmartSaha may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any significant changes will be communicated on this page with an updated effective date. We encourage you to review this policy periodically.
section8_text: For questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy, please contact:

faq1Answer: Our solutions are designed for every stakeholder in Madagascar's agricultural value chain: individual producers, cooperatives, agribusinesses, as well as NGOs and development projects.
faq2Question: How does the app work in areas without internet access?
faq2Answer: SmartSaha uses an Offline-First architecture. You can collect data, geolocate parcels, and record field information without a network connection. As soon as an internet connection is detected, the data syncs automatically.
faq3Question: What are the benefits of GIS parcel mapping?
faq3Answer: GIS mapping makes it possible to calculate the exact size of farms, monitor vegetation health through satellite imagery, and guarantee the rigorous traceability required by local and international markets.
faq4Question: How can I get a demo of the platform?
faq4Answer: Simply click the Request a Demo button or contact us directly through our form. Our team will schedule a presentation tailored to your specific needs.
